boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 108 uses a compact 6×6 grid where the left-rail numbers are live progress markers, not decoration. A red star cluster anchors the center and a bottom star bar seals the final exit. The real constraint is the right-rail `10` tile: sliding it too early blocks the lower feed lane while the star bar still needs room to clear.
landmarks: Block Out Level 108 uses a compact 6×6 grid where the left-rail numbers are live progress markers, not decoration.
A red star cluster anchors the center and a bottom star bar seals the final exit.
The real constraint is the right-rail `10` tile: sliding it too early blocks the lower feed lane while the star bar still needs room to clear.

quickTips: Use the left-rail counts as a checklist — top count must reach `8` before the bottom star bar can drop.
Keep the lower-center gap open while peeling the left green column.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Break up the upper-middle red star cluster before moving side singles.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the left green column while keeping the lower-center gap open.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Shift the orange vertical bar only after the left-rail top count drops from `11` to `8`.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining blue and cyan singles once the left-rail middle counts read `6` and `1`.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the right-rail `10` tile out through the right green arrow lane.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Send the bottom orange star bar through the downward arrow exit.

failurePoints: Moving the right-rail `10` tile before the left-rail top count reaches `8`.
Filling the lower-center gap too early, which removes the star bar's drop lane.
